first_in_archive: Tonight the Bottle Let Me Down

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It Hurts Me Too** (2 reviews): Duane's playing on BIODTL and It Hurts Me Too is singled out as the highlight; Sugar Magnolia is merely okay; Interplay between the band with Duane and Pigpen's vocals on Hurts Me Too is praised as phenomenal [17][20]
- **BIODTL** (2 reviews): Duane's BIODTL solo is said to take command and outplay Jerry, who rarely got upstaged otherwise; Allman's slide solo on BIODTL, just 16 bars long, is called the best the reviewer has heard [13][14]
- **Hard to Handle** (1 review): Pig ends Hard to Handle with an ad-libbed line about bringing it round to your house and laying it at your door [16]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): The Sugar Magnolia file opens with about three and a half minutes of tuning before the song starts [10]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): The Good Lovin' improvisation features Phil dropping huge bass bombs [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Brown Eyed Handsome Man**: rare: 4 archived performances [22]
- **Tonight the Bottle Let Me Down**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]
- **Cecilia**: rare: 8 archived performances [22]
- **Truck Drivin' Man**: rare: 14 archived performances [22]
- **All I Ever Wanted**: rare: 9 archived performances [22]
- **Sailin'**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 6 archived performances [22]
- **Glendale Train**: rare: 13 archived performances [22]

## The recordings

- **gd71-04-26.sbd.murphy.4991.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 214 min; rated 4.25/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Duane is mixed more clearly on Hurts Me Too and BIODTL than on Sugar Magnolia; The I Know You Rider track cuts off at 3:17, mid-lyric, in both the single-track and full-show downloads; The Wolfgang's Vault stream of this show is described as having great sound quality [10][11][20]
- **gd1971-04-26.sbd.unknown.2214.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 185 min; rated 2/5 by 5 [2]. Said about its sound: Audio quality is rated excellent, in stereo [21]
- **gd1971-04-26.145130.sbd.kafer.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 142 min [7]
- **gd1971-04-26.sbd.unknown.4330.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 185 min [3]

## Around the show

- The New Riders of the Purple Sage open on this tape with Henry, The Weight, Last Lonely Eagle, Fun Fun Fun and more [21]
- Duane Allman sat in on It Hurts Me Too and Beat It On Down the Line; the New Riders also played [7]
- Reviewer considers this the weakest night of the April 1971 Fillmore East run, though still good [12]
- Good Lovin' with the drum section is fabulous but falls short of the previous night's version, which had a Pig rap [12]
- Reviewer prefers this Hard to Handle to the 4/29 one: tighter jamming and better bass response [16]
- The Dark Star into Wharf Rat is nice but not as good as the one on 2/18/71 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-04-26.sbd.murphy.4991.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Bill Gadsden; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: The Grateful Dead portion descends from a master reel to CDR to SHN transfer; The New Riders material came via a separate chain and was newly seeded; credits go to Bill Gadsden, Jim Wise and John Oleynick [1]
- **gd1971-04-26.sbd.unknown.2214.shnf**: transferred by shn conversion & ftp uploading by Bob Murphy; source: MSR 7 inch (7.5 ips) Revox A 77 >Alesis Masterlink>CD-R [2]
- **gd1971-04-26.145130.sbd.kafer.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Will Boswells copy Peter Kafer; transferred by Will Boswell, Matt Smith, Sirmick; source: Master Soundboard Reel 7.5 ips > Reel - Will Boswells copy Peter Kafer [7]. Also: A patch source, shnid 105815, fills gaps in the first two minutes of Big Boss Man and parts of Wharf Rat [7]
- **gd1971-04-26.sbd.unknown.4330.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: Soundboard [3]
